description:
This Thursday, we are honored to welcome a man whose name has become synonymous with both controversy and courage: Dr. Andrew Wakefield.Show more Dr. Wakefield was one of the first physicians to raise public concerns about the MMR vaccine, the growing childhood vaccine schedule, and a potential link to autism and gastrointestinal disease in children. For asking hard scientific questions and advocating for further research, he was targeted, silenced, and discredited by the very institutions tasked with protecting public health.
Now, more than two decades later, as chronic illness and neurodevelopmental disorders skyrocket among children—and as thousands of parents share eerily similar stories—many are beginning to ask the question: Was Dr. Wakefield right all along?
In this in-depth and deeply personal interview, Dr. Wakefield joins Steve Kirsch to discuss:
His early research and the professional fallout that followed
Why the MMR-autism question was never truly answered—just buried
The explosion of childhood chronic illness and what it reveals about the vaccine schedule
His feature film, Protocol 7—a gripping, medically accurate thriller based on true events, including vaccine injury, whistleblower testimony, and the corrupt systems working to cover it all up
This is more than a scientific conversation. It’s a look at what happens when truth threatens power—and the high personal cost of standing up for families who had no voice.
Whether you’re new to Dr. Wakefield’s story or you’ve followed his work for years, this is a must-watch episode that goes far beyond the headlines.
Tune in Thursday at 7 PM ET / 4 PM PT on VSRF LIVE, streaming on Rumble and X.
